passive.name: Sprout
passive.text: Increases the wearer's CRIT Rate by **18/21/24/27/30%**. When any ally character consumes a total of **4** or more Skill Points in a single turn, the wearer gains "Radiant Crown," lasting for **3** turn(s). While the wearer holds "Radiant Crown," all allies' DMG dealt ignores **20/24/28/32/36%** of the target's DEF, and the Skill DMG dealt by the wearer increases by **72/84/96/108/120%**. Effects of the same type cannot stack.

weapons.name: Life Should Be Cast to Flames

passive.name: Smelt
passive.text:
When the wearer's turn starts, regenerates **10** Energy. If the enemy target has a Weakness implanted by the wearer, increases the wearer's DMG dealt to it by **60/70/80/90/100%**.
When an enemy target gets attacked by the wearer, the wearer decreases the target's DEF by **12/15/18/21/24%**, lasting for **2** turn(s). The same types of effects cannot stack.

passive.name: Mind Game
passive.text: Increases the wearer's CRIT Rate by **12/14/16/18/20%**. When the wearer uses their Ultimate, increases the wearer's Skill DMG and Ultimate DMG dealt by **60/70/80/90/100%**, lasting for **3** turn(s). After the wearer uses their Ultimate, if this Ultimate consumed **140** or more Energy, recovers 1 Skill Point.

passive.name: Boundless Thought
passive.text: Increases the wearer's ATK by **8/9/10/11/12%**. After using an attack, for each enemy target hit, additionally increases ATK by **4/5/6/7/8%**. This effect can stack up to 5 times and last until the next attack. If there are **3** or more enemy targets hit, this unit's SPD increases by **8/10/12/14/16%**, lasting for **1** turn(s).

passive.name: A Storm Is Coming
passive.text: After entering battle, increases the wearer's DMG based on their Max Energy. Each point of Energy increases DMG by **0.2/0.25/0.3/0.35/0.4%**. A max of **160** Energy will be taken into account for this.

passive.name: The Power of Sound
passive.text: The wearer regenerates **20/23/26/29/32** Energy immediately upon entering battle, and increases DMG dealt by the wearer's Ultimate by **32/40/48/56/64%**.

substatLine: SPD until desired goal > CRIT Rate / CRIT DMG > ATK%
tracePriority: Elegant Conduct (A2) > Ladylike Poise (A4) > Inbound Prosperity (A6)

entries.name: Bajiquan
entries.text: Deals Quantum DMG equal to **100%** of Rin Tohsaka's ATK to one designated enemy.

entries.name: Jeweled Sword Zelretch
entries.text: Deals Quantum DMG equal to **180%** of Rin Tohsaka's ATK to one designated enemy.

entries.name: Second Magic Experiment
entries.text: Deals Quantum DMG equal to **90%** of Rin Tohsaka's ATK to all enemies. Then, consumes **3** "Gem Energy" to additionally deal Quantum DMG equal to **90%** of Rin Tohsaka's ATK to one random enemy target. This repeats until "Gem Energy" is less than **3** or there are no enemy targets with current HP greater than 0. Can repeat up to **33** cycle(s). When used, if the current Skill Points are greater than **2**, consumes Skill Points down to **2**, and for each Point consumed, immediately gains **2** "Gem Energy."

entries.name: An Gal Ta Ki Gal Šè
entries.text: Deals Quantum DMG equal to **600%** of Rin Tohsaka's ATK to one designated enemy, and Quantum DMG equal to **200%** of Rin Tohsaka's ATK to other enemy targets. When used, recovers **1** Skill Point(s) for allies, and increases the DMG taken by all enemies by **20%**, lasting for **3** turn(s).

entries.name: Gem Magecraft
entries.text: When entering combat, gains **20** "Gem Energy." When an ally target consumes or recovers Skill Points, increases their CRIT DMG by **70%** for **2** turn(s). For every 1 Skill Point consumed or recovered, Rin Tohsaka gains 1 "Gem Energy." If Rin Tohsaka holds **15** or more "Gem Energy," or if the current Skill Points are **7** or more, her Skill is enhanced to "Second Magic Experiment."

entries.name: Freeform Tohsaka Style
entries.text: After Archer uses his Skill "Caladbolg II: Fake Spiral Sword" to attack, if Skill Points are **3** or fewer or if "Caladbolg II: Fake Spiral Sword" has been actively used 5 times during the current "Circuit Connection" state, and the Joint Follow-Up ATK from "Freeform Tohsaka Style" has not been triggered, Rin Tohsaka and Archer will launch Joint Follow-Up ATK on all enemies, dealing Quantum DMG equal to **300%** of Rin Tohsaka's ATK and **300%** of Archer's ATK respectively, and recovering **4** Skill Point(s) for allies. This Joint Follow-Up ATK can only trigger once. The trigger count resets when Rin Tohsaka's turn ends.

entries.name: Conversion Charge
entries.text: After using Technique, gains **10** "Gem Energy" at the start of the next battle.

entries.name: Elegant Conduct
entries.text: While Rin Tohsaka is on the field, additionally increases the upper limit of Skill Points by **2**. When entering combat, Rin Tohsaka's ATK increases by **150%**, and Quantum RES PEN increases by **15%**. If Archer is in the team, Archer also gains this effect.

entries.name: Ladylike Poise
entries.text: When entering combat or after using Enhanced Skill, increases Rin Tohsaka's SPD by **20%**, lasting for **3** turn(s).

entries.name: Inbound Prosperity
entries.text: When Rin Tohsaka uses Ultimate, gains **12** "Gem Energy."

entries.name: Zelretch's Apprentice
entries.text:
If one instance of the Enhanced Skill consumes 30 or more "Gem Energy," Rin Tohsaka gains "Shadow Gem" equal to the amount of "Gem Energy" consumed.
While holding "Shadow Gem," enhances Skill to "Second Magic Experiment." The Enhanced Skill consumes all "Shadow Gem," does not trigger the effect that converts Skill Points into "Gem Energy," and does not consume "Gem Energy."

entries.name: Dimensional Traveler
entries.text: Rin Tohsaka's Skill DMG dealt increases by 30%. While Rin Tohsaka is on the field, Skill DMG dealt by all allies becomes 130% of the original DMG.

entries.name: Holy Grail War: Victory Memorial
entries.text:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

entries.name: Red Devil: Triple Speed
entries.text: When the CRIT DMG boost effect from the Talent "Gem Magecraft" applies to Rin Tohsaka, the effect can stack, up to 2 time(s).

entries.name: Goddess of Venus's Favor
entries.text:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

entries.name: Nailed It This Time!
entries.text: Rin Tohsaka's All-Type RES PEN increases by 20%. When using Ultimate, gains 24 "Gem Energy" and 1 extra turn.
